title: Quantum Computation by Adiabatic Evolution
relevance: Foundational paper proposing adiabatic quantum computation, where the solution to an optimization problem is encoded in the ground state of a Hamiltonian reached via slow evolution. Establishes the theoretical basis for quantum annealing approaches to QUBO problems like Collatz delay maximization.

title: Ising formulations of many NP problems
relevance: Comprehensive catalog of QUBO/Ising formulations for NP-complete and NP-hard problems. Provides the methodological template for casting Collatz delay maximization as a QUBO and connecting it to the broader landscape of combinatorial optimization.

title: Theory of Quantum Annealing of an Ising Spin Glass
relevance: Introduces quantum annealing as a method for finding ground states of Ising spin glasses, demonstrating advantages over classical simulated annealing in certain landscapes. Relevant to understanding when quantum-inspired solvers may outperform classical methods on the QUBO delay problem.
